name: Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd
title: Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd - 530117 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue +22% with ~6.5% volume and ~8% price; capacity rises to 54,000 MT after Phase 1 by June 2026, guidance of 20% growth and 20%+ EBITDA margin, but Q4 gross margin dipped and capex ramp is calibrated.

utilisation.quote: plant utilizations remained healthy across major product lines

triggers.label: Capacity to 54,000 MT by June 2026
triggers.quote: Total installed capacity will increase to 54,000 metric tons per annum after this phase of expansion.

triggers.label: Realisation up ~8% in FY26
triggers.quote: about 8% odd increase in the prices, in fact.

triggers.label: 20% growth, 20%+ EBITDA margin
triggers.quote: we expect to sustain a 20% plus EBITDA margins going forward

triggers.label: Q4 gross margin dipped sequentially
triggers.quote: We have seen a significant dip in gross margin sequentially.

guidance.quote: We are confident of showing a growth of 20% in the coming year.
we expect to sustain a 20% plus EBITDA margins going forward

guidance.value: INR5,000 crore revenue, INR1,000 crore+ EBITDA in 3 to 4 years
guidance.quote: INR5,000 crore of revenue and INR1,000 crore plus in the EBITDA numbers over the next 3 to 4 years
this year, we expect almost INR130 crore of sales instead of INR55 crore last year

red_flags.label: Working capital cycle 117 days; management expects rise up to 3-5%
red_flags.quote: Even if it increases, it won't be more than 3% to 4%

red_flags.label: Furfural backward integration ~2 years out; molecules not yet commercial
red_flags.quote: it will be post, I would say, 2 years

evasions.quote: So spot customers, these are all very dedicated questions. These calls are recorded. So we won't be able to share
we are putting a demonstration plant, which will come up in the next probably 12 months or so
I think you should consider you always stay safe.
I would hesitate to give you margins around that.
